seasons.photo_credit: Photos via Peacock's official cast reveal.
draft_rules: All 23 castmates get drafted before the season starts. The pick order is the reverse of the Season 5 standings: RJ, then Damon, then Em, then back to RJ, and so on until all 23 are taken. Since 23 doesn't divide evenly by three, RJ and Damon end up with 8 players each; Em gets 7.
Only each team's top 7 scorers count toward the team score. For an 8-player roster, the lowest scorer is dropped, and this is recalculated after every episode.

seasons.label: Season 5
seasons.photo_credit: Photos and hometowns via NBC's official cast reveal.
draft_rules: All 22 castmates get drafted before the season starts. Picks go in a fixed repeating order: Damon, then Em, then RJ, then back to Damon, and so on until all 22 are taken. Since 22 doesn't divide evenly by three, Damon picks first each cycle and ends up with 8 players; Em and RJ each get 7.
Only each team's top 7 scorers count toward the team score. For Damon's 8-player roster, his lowest scorer is dropped, and this is recalculated after every episode.
